a pro-se / counsel-of-record flag on query rows, or a statpack cut by applicant class, since that is the dimension that moved this forecast most

notes: Forward cell; ~7 corpus/MCP calls total, well under budget. The pooled 10.5% interim baseline is a coarse yardstick for a pro se state-trial-court application; the applicant class, not the pool, drove the number.
